description: Skelet AF-06-ii optional video-evidence attachment to assembled reports

compatibility.instructions: Does adding an optional observed.videoEvidence field plus attachVideoEvidence and a record validator change the frozen report schema, the base assembly path, downstream manifest/export consumers, or any dependency? The base path is untouched (no key added without attach); downstream reads digests only; validator is additive. Do existing callers keep working?

correctness.instructions: Is the attachment factually correct: input report shape-checked, evidence re-authenticated (schema/shapes/mapping/uniform dims/digest recompute), no silent overwrite, input never mutated, provenance extended without duplication, identity recomputed with the same domain separation? Is partial-selection validity (ceiling, not identity) correctly handled?

evidence.instructions: Are the 2 attachment tests sufficient: deterministic extension with provenance/identity checks and input-immutability, plus re-attach/retimed/reshaDigest/emptied/null/wrong-schema/non-report rejections? Full lens suite 197/197 with typecheck/lint clean?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterminism: pure functions, fixed timestamps, sorted provenance appends, digest-bound identity? Any double-attach or mutation aliasing risk?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond the attachment slice: decoders, capture changes, surfaces, paid services, or unrelated refactors? Is worker/route exposure correctly left out?

security.instructions: Does attachment weaken any control: untrusted records re-authenticated at attach time, substitution invalidates digests, no network/codec/secrets, ReportError on all malformed paths? Any confusion between declared and observed data?

state.change: AF-06-ii: attachVideoEvidence plus validateVideoEvidenceRecord binding optional video evidence into reports with recomputed identity; 2 attachment tests.
